pool.text: An artificial canal was dug between the two island halves to enforce racial segregation.
The Amalgamation Ceremony unified the North and South protectorates to form Nigeria.
Yaba College of Technology was founded as Nigeria's first higher educational institution.
Independence was proclaimed at the Tafawa Balewa Square stadium.
The creation of Lagos State led to the splitting of Lagos city.
American musician James Brown performed a concert in the city.
Military ruler Murtala Muhammed was assassinated near the barracks on Ikoyi Road.
The government decided to relocate the national capital to the city of Abuja.
The international airport terminal was built and commissioned over forty years ago.
The international airport terminal opened officially in March.
The seat of government officially relocated from Lagos to Abuja.
The United Nations predicted the metropolitan area population would exceed 20 million.
Lagos served as an African platform city for the Documenta 11 art exhibition.
The metro area extended beyond state boundaries and attained a megacity status.
The Trans African Highway represents a planning proposal originating from this year.
The Bus Rapid Transit system was officially inaugurated in Lagos.
The film The Figurine set new box office revenue records in Nigeria.
A radical makeover began at the airport following a government remodeling programme launch.
The film 93 Days documented the Ebola outbreak in the city.
The healthcare system successfully contained an outbreak of the Ebola virus.
